equity_weekly.horizon: 7 calendar days with exchange-session outcome matching

cepe_next_open.horizon: prior close to next session opening observation
cepe_next_open.note: Opening observation is not represented as an executable fill.

catalyst_ablation.instrument: matched equity or option lane instrument
catalyst_ablation.comparison: same frozen strategy with versus without eligible pre-issue catalyst features

candidate_features.source_requirement: raw timestamped NSE/BSE filing bytes plus official URL and SHA-256
candidate_features.reason: Test whether point-in-time filing category adds OOS value after a no-catalyst baseline.

candidate_features.source_requirement: published, disseminated, first-observed, and prediction-issued timestamps with timezone
candidate_features.missingness_policy: missing or inconsistent timestamps make the feature ineligible
candidate_features.reason: Measure information freshness without backfilling later announcements.

candidate_features.source_requirement: dated fee schedule plus observed spread/slippage inputs
candidate_features.missingness_policy: strategy result NOT_PROVEN until conservative costs are supplied
candidate_features.reason: Prevent gross-return promotion that disappears after realistic costs.

candidate_features.source_requirement: Exact retained official issuer filing bytes, exchange dissemination timestamp and first-observed timestamp; currency and amount parsed explicitly.
candidate_features.missingness_policy: Missing or ineligible before max(exchange dissemination, first observation); do not infer zero from an absent filing, backdate knowledge, or substitute a document date for publication time.
candidate_features.reason: Pre-register whether disclosed subsidiary capital infusion adds incremental predictive information beyond the frozen no-catalyst baseline. Company scale is a required control before interpreting absolute amounts; no bullish sign or usefulness is presumed.

experiment_contract.evaluation: Separate chronological train/validation/new untouched test for each instrument and horizon; paired with/without-catalyst ablation on the identical cohort and cost assumptions.
experiment_contract.multiple_testing_control: Count this as an additional candidate experiment in the promotion family; include deflated-Sharpe and required multiplicity controls before promotion.

measured_counts.note: Four unique official filing PDFs inspected cumulatively; this does not establish any pre-issued prediction or measured catalyst contribution. Fixtures are excluded; later measured return remains NOT_PROVEN.
